entities.name: Vicente Ferreira da Silva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vicente Ferreira da Silva was a Brazilian logician, mathematician, and philosopher. He was among the first in Brazil to write and publish academic books on Logic and Phenomenology, with a special interest in Heidegger.
